achievetodo.root.description: Familiar Minecraft mechanics are locked! Complete advancements to unlock them again!
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.rewards.i: You will receive items for completing advancements. For example, several logs for the first felling of a tree.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.rewards.e: You will receive experience for completing advancements. The most difficult advancements are especially well rewarded.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.rewards.t: You will receive exclusive collectibles for completing advancements. For example, an unbreakable iron axe for collecting a stack of each type of wood log.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.generatio: Terralith - 85+ new biomes, original structures, and endless features.
Amplified Nether - make the Nether 256 blocks tall while also bringing in the "Amplified" feel.
Nullscape - a better ending. Shattered islands, floating valleys, and infinite variation.
achievetodo.world_creation_tab.lan.coope: Makes it so that whenever a player gets an advancement, that advancement will be shared across all players.
